description_expanded: ⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: Wooden beams and framing have been installed on the balconies as part of preparations for future community projects. These structures partially reduce the views from the balconies, including the pool area. 🛑The elevator in Building 1 is out of service & not accessible.30A ESCAPES presents… “The Pointe Unit 122,” a luxury 2nd floor condo at The Pointe on 30A. This spacious 2-bedroom retreat features two private balconies, upscale interiors, and resort-style amenities—all just a 5-min walk to beach access and Rosemary Town Center. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Location: 5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town CenterTwo Private Balconies: Enjoy outdoor relaxation, lounging, or diningSpacious Layout: Open concept kitchen and living areasUpscale Kitchen: Quartz counters, stainless appliances, island seating for 4Two Comfortable Bedrooms with spa-inspired bathroomsResort Amenities: Pool, hot tub, fire pits, grills, and fitness centerOn-Site Dining: 'Big Bad Breakfast' just downstairsBikes Included: 2 adult bikes for exploring 30A*** LIVING AREAS ***This 2nd floor condo features a welcoming open-concept layout with cozy seating and a flat screen TV—ideal for relaxing after your beach day or entertaining with family and friends.Open-concept living and dining areaFlat screen TVStylish, coastal-inspired furnishings*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring stainless appliances, quartz countertops, and a large island with seating. One of the private balconies also offers a dining table for 4—perfect for enjoying meals outdoors.Full-size kitchen with stainless steel appliancesQuartz countertops and ample cabinetryIsland with seating for 4Balcony dining table with seating for 4—perfect for al fresco meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Two private balconies offer flexible outdoor living spaces—ideal for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or dining under the stars. The community’s resort-style amenities are just steps away.Two private balconies with lounge seatingOne balcony includes a dining table—seating for 4Resort-style pool and oversized hot tubGas grills, fire pits, and shaded lounge areasOn-site restaurant ‘Big Bad Breakfast’*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Primary Suite: King-size bed, flat screen TV, private En-suite with soaking tub, walk-in shower, dual vanities, and access to private balconyQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size bed, En-suite bathroom with walk-in shower and dual vanities*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located near Rosemary and Inlet Beach, this condo places you at the heart of 30A’s most desirable attractions. Spend your days exploring boutique shops and dining at 30Avenue, wandering the charming streets of Rosemary Beach, or adventuring through the natural beauty of Camp Helen State Park, where hiking trails and coastal dune lakes await.5-minute walk to Rosemary Beach Town Center5-minute walk to Winston Lane Public Beach AccessSteps to ‘Big Bad Breakfast’ and other local favorites2-minute bike ride to 30Avenue—shopping, dining, and seasonal events10-minute drive to Camp Helen State Park—hiking, paddling, and natural beauty*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 2 provided bikes. The elevator in Building 1 is out of service & not accessible. *** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 220326
